title: Find Number of Coins to Place in Tree Nodes
sourceKind: search results citing the LeetCode statement and a community repository
summary: Each node has a subtree. A subtree with fewer than 3 nodes gets 1 coin. Otherwise the node gets the maximum product of three distinct subtree costs, or 0 if that product is negative.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps the tree at 50 nodes and cost magnitudes at 10000.
